caption: The drawing depicts a wooden writing desk, specifically a slant-front or drop-front secretary desk, placed against a plain, light-colored background. The desk features a rectangular shape with a slanted front panel that likely folds down to create a writing surface. Below this slanted section, there are three horizontal drawers stacked vertically, each equipped with two dark metal handles and centrally placed escutcheons. The desk rests on short, bracket feet, and the wood is rendered in shades of brown with visible grain patterns. The hardware, including handles and keyhole plates, is depicted in a dark metallic color, contrasting with the lighter, warm tone of the wood. The drawing uses a combination of brown, tan, and black shades to emphasize wood texture and shadows, giving a sense of depth and dimension to the object. There are no additional objects or decorations around or on the desk, and the background remains unembellished and neutral.
title: Child's Desk
